summary: Multi-line text input with built-in label and supporting text.

usage.text: Only required (whitespace-only counts as empty) and invalid affect validity. The maxlength attribute is passed to the native textarea but is not reported through validity. A readonly field is never invalid.
The rows attribute falls back to 4 when it is not a positive number.

a11y.text: The textarea is described only by its supporting text; an aria-describedby on the host is not forwarded.
